description: Rules for secure development of software and systems are not established and applied. This signal indicates that the organization lacks a formal secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) with security integrated into planning, design, development, testing, and deployment phases.
applicability: Applicable to all software development activities including custom application development, system integration, infrastructure as code, automation scripts, APIs, microservices, mobile applications, and any software or system modification. Includes internal development teams and third-party development.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of software development policies and procedures, SDLC documentation, security requirements in development projects, security design reviews, threat modeling practices, secure coding standards, and development workflow analysis. May also be identified through absence of security gates in CI/CD pipelines.
